action_items: INFO — All V6.25.10 P0 acceptance criteria PASS. No blocking issues.
MINOR — Mobile sticky-tab top is 48px, spec wrote 12px. Decide whether to honor spec literally or keep 48px (which leaves room for the global app header). Non-blocking.

MINOR — For a Weapon Attribute, the Customise panel ALSO renders the 'Item · BESM Extras' subgroup in addition to 'Weapon · BESM Extras'. Spec stated 'For a Weapon Attribute… 2 groups: standard + Weapon Extras' implying only Weapon-Extras. Current implementation shows BOTH (Weapon-Extras AND Item-Extras) on Weapon, which is arguably correct (weapons inherit item-level extras like Compact/Tied to Owner/Easily Lost). For Item attribute only Item-Extras shows (no Weapon-Extras), so Item gating works as-spec. Confirm this design choice or restrict Weapon to weapon-extras only.

OPTIONAL — Consider seeding a long-lived BESM character with a non-Item/non-Weapon attribute (e.g., Force Field) to enable live UI verification of the negative-gating case. Backend already enforces gating logically; this is for UI regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: CharacterSheet.jsx (1140 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling. AddToMacroButton subcomponent + macroSeed state are clean; consider extracting the Mechanics/Inventory/History tabs into separate files in a future refactor cycle.

AddToMacroButton testid pattern token.replace(/[{}:]/g,'-') produces double-dash testids like 'add-to-macro--stat-body-'. Functional but cosmetically odd. Consider trimming consecutive/leading/trailing dashes for readability — non-blocking.
MacroBuilder portal + z-[200] continues to behave correctly for the new wand-launched seed path (verified parentElement.tagName==='BODY' after wand click). Fix from V6.25.9 holds.

Mobile sticky-tab pattern in main scroll container (overflow-y:auto) creates the sticky containing block at <main> not viewport. position=sticky top=48px works correctly when scrolling main; this is the textbook pattern and is fine. (window.scrollTo at root won't move main, requiring main.scrollTop instead — this is a Playwright testing nuance, not a bug.)

ModSection BESM-Extras subgroup labels use display strings with non-ASCII separator '·' (U+00B7). Testids preserve this character. Works in Chromium, but worth noting any future test framework that strict-validates ASCII attribute selectors might choke. Non-blocking.
besm_data.py pool entries all carry source.book='BESM Extras' + numeric source.page — meets ref-table contract. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: V6.25.10 acceptance is GREEN. Gotchas for next iteration: (1) `<main>` element has overflow:hidden auto — sticky tabs are sticky relative to <main>, not viewport. To Playwright-scroll the sheet on mobile, use `document.querySelector('main').scrollTop = N`, NOT `window.scrollTo`. (2) wait_for_selector('sheet-tabs') after navigation; the app-loading-screen testid is the only one available initially (~3-5 second hydration). (3) Eli's sheet at /app/characters/07a6f21a14be4ea9ada50e6db8727ad3 is the canonical UI smoke target — has 1 Item attr (Apocophea Bag), 1 Weapon attr (Lacrosse Staff), 1 defect (Phobia), 2 skills (Artisan/Athletics) — exactly what's needed to exercise all sprinkle types. (4) Sprinkle testid format is `add-to-macro--<token-segment>-` with leading and trailing dashes due to {/}/: replacement. (5) BESM Extras subgroup labels include U+00B7 middle-dot in the testid — preserve verbatim. (6) Currently a Weapon attr renders BOTH Weapon-Extras AND Item-Extras subgroups; if main agent restricts this to only Weapon-Extras, the testid `attr-*-group-label-{idx}-Item-·-BESM-Extras` should disappear from Weapon attr — adjust test accordingly.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The first browser run returned macroCount=0 because we evaluated DOM during the app-loading-screen state (only one testid present). Adding wait_for_selector('sheet-tabs') before evaluation resolved this. The mobile sticky-scroll initial bbox.top=-577 result was a Playwright artifact (window.scrollTo doesn't move the actual scroller, which is <main>); switching to main.scrollTop confirmed sticky behaviour is correct. No code changes required from main agent for V6.25.10.
